haiku.problem: The verses say the crowd got into boats and went to Capernaum, then found Jesus on the other side of the sea. The question says they 'crossed the sea to Capernaum,' which misstates the route.
The answer 'His word' was changed to 'His miracles' even though it breaks no rule, and trivia.md says to keep the card's answers unless one breaks a rule.
